test.create_query: CREATE TABLE t_json_merge_paths_into_shared_data (id UInt64, json JSON(max_dynamic_paths = 32)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS min_bytes_for_wide_part = 0, min_rows_for_wide_part = 0, vertical_merge_algorithm_min_rows_to_activate = 1, vertical_merge_algorithm_min_columns_to_activate = 1, object_serialization_version = 'v3', object_shared_data_serialization_version = 'advanced', object_shared_data_serialization_version_for_zero_level_parts = 'map_with_buckets'
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO t_json_merge_paths_into_shared_data SELECT number, ('{' || arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(i -> '"p' || toString(intDiv(number, 100000) * 32 + i) || '":' || multiIf(i % 4 = 0, '"s' || toString(number + i) || '"', i % 4 = 1, toString(number + i), i % 4 = 2, toString((number + i) / 4), if((number + i) % 2 = 0, 'true', 'false')), range(32)), ',') || '}')::JSON FROM numbers(0, 100000)
